title: One drawing becomes an anime short
pitch: One sentence in. A key visual, its animation, doubled frames and an original score out.
why: Each model does the one thing it is best at. Anima holds the drawn style, Wan 2.2 moves it, FILM makes the motion smooth, and ACE-Step writes a score that fits the length.

fields.label: The scene
fields.default: a colossal rusted walking machine covered in moss and wildflowers, standing knee deep in a flooded green valley, waterfalls behind it, pale morning mist

models.name: Anima
models.note: Non-commercial: this whole result can't be sold while it contains Anima frames.

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: Anima is non-commercial: swap the first stage for your own art if you need to sell the result.

steps.label: Key visual 1
steps.does: The look of the whole short comes from these pictures.
steps.prompt: {scene}, very wide shot, a tiny engineer in an orange coat on its shoulder, hand-painted background, soft morning light

steps.label: Motion 1
steps.does: Animates the drawing without redrawing it.
steps.prompt: Mist drifts through the valley and waterfalls pour steadily behind the huge still machine. The camera slowly pushes in. Anime style, smooth hand-drawn motion.

steps.label: Smooth 1
steps.does: Adds a new frame between each pair, so the motion runs at twice the frame rate.

steps.label: Key visual 2
steps.does: A second drawing in the same style.
steps.prompt: close-up of the moss-covered iron head of a colossal rusted walking machine, one round lens eye glowing soft amber, wildflowers growing from its brow, water dripping, hand-painted background, soft morning light

steps.label: Motion 2
steps.prompt: The round amber eye slowly brightens and water drips from the iron brow while the flowers sway in the wind. The camera stays almost still. Anime style, smooth hand-drawn motion.

steps.label: Key visual 3
steps.does: A third drawing in the same style.
steps.prompt: low angle from the water, the giant iron foot of a colossal rusted walking machine lifting out of a flooded green valley, water pouring off it in sheets, hand-painted background, soft morning light

steps.label: Motion 3
steps.prompt: The giant iron foot rises slowly out of the water, sheets of water pour from it and ripples spread toward the camera. Anime style, smooth hand-drawn motion.

steps.label: The score

94.tags: Orchestral anime film score: solo oboe over warm strings and soft taiko, slow, hopeful and vast, no vocals

steps.does: An original instrumental, long enough for the three shots.

steps.label: Three shots
steps.does: Runs the three shots together with soft dissolves.

steps.label: Marry picture and score
steps.does: Joins picture and score at broadcast loudness.
